items.source: MultiValueBinding creates a Predicate out of given Path and collection value. Used for specific parameter treatment in QuerydslBindings.
items.translation: MultiValueBinding 根据给定的 Path 和集合值创建 Predicate。该接口用于在 QuerydslBindings 中进行特定的参数处理。

items.source: Returns the predicate to be applied to the given Path for the given collection value, which will contain all values submitted for the path bind.
items.translation: 返回一个谓词，该谓词将应用于给定的 `Path` 以处理集合值，该集合值包含路径绑定提交的所有值。

items.source: Returns the predicate to be applied to the given Path for the given collection value, which will contain all values submitted for the path bind. If a single value was provided only the collection will consist of exactly one element.
items.translation: 返回一个谓词，该谓词将应用于给定的 `Path` 以处理集合值。此集合将包含绑定路径提交的所有值。如果仅提供了一个单一值，则该集合将恰好只包含一个元素。

items.source: can be Optional.empty(), in which case the binding will not be incorporated in the overall Predicate.
items.translation: 可以是 `Optional.empty()`，在这种情况下，该绑定将不会纳入整体的 `Predicate` 中。

items.source: path - Path to the property. Will not be null.
value - the value that should be bound. Will not be null or empty.
items.translation: `value` - 要绑定的值。该值不会为 null 或空。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
